description.value:
Your nanites shape your body into a fluid weapon with customized features as you require them. When you use this action, you gain a nanite unarmed attack for 1 minute. Your nanite unarmed attack deals 1d6 damage, has the tech trait, and is in the brawling group. When you use this action, choose from bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing, and choose two of the following traits: finesse, forceful, razing, shove, or trip. Your nanite unarmed attack deals that type of damage and has those traits.

Special You can use Alteration Array as a free action triggered when you roll for initiative instead of using Gear Array.
